name: Voyage AI
short: State-of-the-art text, multimodal, and code embedding models with rerankers; generous 200M free tokens on sign-up.

plans.name: Free Tier
plans.notes: Instant API key upon account registration (no credit card required). Includes 200 million free tokens for general and code embeddings (voyage-4, voyage-4-lite, voyage-4-large, voyage-code-3) and 150 billion pixels for multimodal models; 300 RPM rate limit.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Volume billing beyond free allowance: voyage-4-lite at $0.02/1M tokens, voyage-4 at $0.06/1M tokens, voyage-4-large at $0.12/1M tokens, rerankers at $0.05/1k searches.
